name: galaxie
description: A browser-first agent runtime SDK for web apps.

scripts.build: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/adapter-langgraph/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/models/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/react/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p examples/english-tutor/tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/build-manifest.ts examples/english-tutor && node scripts/build-manifest.ts examples/english-tutor --verify && pnpm --filter @galaxie/example-host-local build && tsc -p packages/storage-indexeddb/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p examples/mcp-server/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/tools-mcp/tsconfig.build.json && pnpm --filter @galaxie/example-host-remote build && tsc -p packages/eslint-plugin/tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check: pnpm run check:license && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run typecheck:ts6 && pnpm run test && pnpm run build && pnpm run check:deps && pnpm run check:docs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/core/test && tsc -p packages/adapter-langgraph && tsc -p packages/adapter-langgraph/test && tsc -p tests/conformance && tsc -p scripts && tsc -p packages/models && tsc -p packages/models/test && tsc -p packages/react && tsc -p packages/react/test && tsc -p examples/english-tutor && tsc -p examples/english-tutor/test && tsc -p examples/host-local && tsc -p examples/host-local/test && tsc -p packages/storage-indexeddb && tsc -p packages/storage-indexeddb/test && tsc -p examples/mcp-server && tsc -p examples/mcp-server/test && tsc -p packages/tools-mcp && tsc -p packages/tools-mcp/test && tsc -p examples/host-remote && tsc -p examples/host-remote/test && tsc -p packages/eslint-plugin && tsc -p packages/eslint-plugin/test
scripts.typecheck:ts6: tsc6 -p packages/core && tsc6 -p packages/core/test && tsc6 -p packages/adapter-langgraph && tsc6 -p packages/adapter-langgraph/test && tsc6 -p tests/conformance && tsc6 -p scripts && tsc6 -p packages/models && tsc6 -p packages/models/test && tsc6 -p packages/react && tsc6 -p packages/react/test && tsc6 -p examples/english-tutor && tsc6 -p examples/english-tutor/test && tsc6 -p examples/host-local && tsc6 -p examples/host-local/test && tsc6 -p packages/storage-indexeddb && tsc6 -p packages/storage-indexeddb/test && tsc6 -p examples/mcp-server && tsc6 -p examples/mcp-server/test && tsc6 -p packages/tools-mcp && tsc6 -p packages/tools-mcp/test && tsc6 -p examples/host-remote && tsc6 -p examples/host-remote/test && tsc6 -p packages/eslint-plugin && tsc6 -p packages/eslint-plugin/test
